rules.completion_criterion: The assay stops when all 21 declared runs have emitted verbatim text responses, their SHA-256 hashes are recorded in FREEZE B, and blind adjudication is completed across two independent passes.
rules.error_policy: If an individual subagent run fails due to timeout, token exhaustion, or empty response, that single run is discarded and re-executed with a fresh context-isolated instance.
rules.chronology_policy: If any receiver executes before FREEZE_A is remotely addressable on GitHub, the entire assay is declared HELD.
rules.unblinding_policy: Arm identities and the plaintext invariant key remain hidden from adjudication until after FREEZE_B is remotely addressable.
rules.disagreement_policy: Any scoring divergence between Pass 1 and Pass 2 is recorded as an active disagreement; no majority-voting or forced convergence is permitted.
